name: The Alpha's Mission
source: You don't know the importance of your identity. You meet the two shifters, Matt and Cain, at an event. You haven't started your first heat yet so it's not possible for the Alphas to smell you...
translation: 你还不知道自己的身份有多么重要。在一次活动中，你遇见了两位能够变身的男子，马特与凯恩。你的第一次发情期尚未到来，因此阿尔法们还无法闻出你的气息……
